about: Each alert type the analyst bot can post: its display label and its message template. The bot renders the template (Python str.format placeholders) and stores the result in fired_alerts.message, so Discord and Alarm History read the same text; momentum-api serves the labels to the web. Alerts mark onsets: the condition started on the bar named by bar_date after at least 5 sessions without it. Templates describe the condition only; they make no prediction.

bb_squeeze.label: Bollinger squeeze
bb_squeeze.message: Bollinger Squeeze began — the Bollinger Bands are inside the Keltner Channel (recent volatility is low).

liquidity_sweep.label: Liquidity sweep
liquidity_sweep.message: New liquidity sweep on the latest bar: {side} sweep of the {level:.2f} swing level, close {close:.2f}
